source_context: The human requested to begin the highest-priority general Banks sensitivity formalization from LeanFrontier's roadmap. GPT-6 inspected the pinned v4.35.0 dynamics/periodic-point APIs and the Banks proof, then formalized its metric orbit-separation ingredients: two disjoint finite periodic orbits admit a positive common distance bound, and every ambient point is uniformly away from one of the entire orbits. These are prerequisites for, not a claim to have completed, the full transitivity/dense-periodic-point sensitivity theorem. Lean statements and proofs are machine-authored.
